keyFindings.description: Lines 23 and 88 add '(INFRA-647)' to code comments: a new Dispatch key in author-written text on sjawhar/legion, against the standing rule ('Stop new leaks only', relayed by the controller; code comments named explicitly). Delete both parentheticals.

Lines 38-40 claim the markdown assertion alone could not tell under len(slots) > 0. False: typed blocks render their ids (pmdoc/schema.go:286-290), so the reused read would render the pasted callout as #note while the room renders #<stamped>; requireIndexedBlocks only fails first because it runs first (test lines 147-148).
Line 27 tells authors to name the issues that must keep the invariant in AGENTS.md, which the key rule forbids; name the code paths (readSettlementTree, sweepUnrecordedMarks) instead.

Line 45 cites 'the tester's line in the same body' for the either-half negative control; the body's E2E (tester) line does not say it (only test.json does, which retro removes). State the result in the doc.
